expectedIssues: Fastest near you carousel card heights are misaligned with each other
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the Smash Bros Burgers card is offset downward relative to the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards. Its image top, title ('Smash Bros Burgers') and delivery fee sit about 28px lower, so the card titles and prices are misaligned across the row.

The heart (favorite) buttons on the restaurant cards use inconsistent backgrounds. The Tokumaru card uses a light-translucent circle while the pizza card uses a darker, more opaque circle, so the control looks different from card to card.
Secondary gray text, such as the search placeholder, delivery fees and the '25–35 min' meta line, appears low in contrast against the white background, which may be hard to read for some users.
